parameters.content:
BUILD-306 TBK Product Intelligence Engine (single source of truth)

Execute Workflow Trigger. Consumes the BUILD-305 Canonical Product Object plus
vision/taxonomy results and produces ONE product_intelligence object spanning
Product, SEO/GEO/AEO, Shopify (prepared, NOT published), AI Search/Knowledge,
Marketing (scaffold for BUILD-312) and ERP. Stores the full object in
tbk_product_intelligence and returns it.

No business logic is hardcoded: all defaults (vendor, categories, occasions,
flavours, weights, allergens, google category, model, ai toggle, base url) come
from the tbk_pi_config Data Table. SEO copy is generated by OpenAI over HTTP with
continue-on-error and a deterministic fallback, so one optional failure never
stops the workflow.

Downstream hook points (all CONSUME this object, none re-interpret):
- BUILD-307 Shopify Publisher -> product_intelligence.shopify
- BUILD-308 SEO Publisher -> product_intelligence.seo
- BUILD-309 Knowledge Graph -> product_intelligence.ai_search
- BUILD-310 Cake Genome -> product_intelligence.product
- BUILD-311 Recommendation Engine -> product_intelligence.ai_search
- BUILD-312 Marketing Brain -> product_intelligence.marketing (scaffold)
